# @zakkster/lite-audio-pool
> Zero-GC Web Audio sound sprite pool. Voice stealing with 20ms anti-pop fade, pitch shifting, stereo/positional/discrete-surround pan, bus routing, ABA-safe handles.

Version: 1.3.0 (synced with package.json + the VERSION const in AudioPool.js)

## Install
npm i @zakkster/lite-audio-pool

## Import
import { AudioPool } from '@zakkster/lite-audio-pool';

## Key Facts
- Zero GC on the hot path: all state in TypedArrays, `onended` handler bound once per pool (not per play)
- Size: ~2 KB minified, < 1 KB gzipped
- Dependencies: none
- ESM only (type: module)
- Voice stealing with 20 ms anti-pop fade
- Generation-stamped handles: `play()` returns `((gen << 8) | channel) >>> 0`, stale handles are silent no-ops on `stop()`
- Bus routing via constructor `output` param
- Per-play buffer override via `play()` 5th arg
- Constructor validates capacity and sprite table; typos fail at wiring, not at first shot
- `expireTimes` are f64 - stays precise at 24h+ of AudioContext uptime

## Export: AudioPool (class)

### Constructor
```
new AudioPool(ctx, audioBuffer, spriteMap, capacity?, output?, options?)
```
- `ctx: AudioContext` (required)
- `audioBuffer: AudioBuffer` - default decoded sprite file
- `spriteMap: Record<string, { start: number, duration: number }>` (required; validated)
- `capacity?: number` - integer in [1, 256], defaults to 32. Out-of-range throws `RangeError`.
- `output?: AudioNode | null` - defaults to `ctx.destination`. Pass a GainNode to route into a bus.
- `options?: { panner?: 'stereo' | 'positional' | 'discrete', channels?: 4 | 6 | 8 }` -
  per-voice pan node. `'stereo'` (default) uses StereoPannerNode, `pan` writes `.pan`.
  `'positional'` uses PannerNode, `pan` writes `.positionX` (listener at origin facing -Z,
  so +X is right; distanceModel 'inverse' with refDistance 1 gives zero distance attenuation
  across the pan range - loudness stays owned by the gain node). `'discrete'` routes each
  voice through N pre-allocated GainNode lanes into a shared `ChannelMerger(N)`; `channels`
  is REQUIRED and must be 4 (L,R,C,LFE), 6 (+SL,SR), or 8 (+SBL,SBR). One shared lowpass
  band-limits the LFE lane (index 3), summed pool-wide. In discrete mode `pan` is INERT (the
  write lands on a detached per-pool sink, byte-identical hot-path shape); place a voice via
  the lane array returned by `voiceNode()`. Lane defaults: L,R = 0.7071, every other lane
  including LFE = 0.0, so an unpositioned voice plays front-stereo, never dead. Unknown panner
  value throws `RangeError`; a PannerNode lacking positionX throws `TypeError`; discrete
  without a valid `channels`, or `channels` with a non-discrete mode, throws `RangeError`; a
  context lacking `createChannelMerger`/`createBiquadFilter` throws `TypeError`. Default is
  byte-identical to prior releases.

Throws `TypeError` on missing ctx/spriteMap, malformed sprites, or a context that cannot
build the requested mode. Throws `RangeError` on invalid capacity, panner mode, or channels.

### play(spriteId, volume?, pan?, pitch?, buffer?)
Returns a packed handle `((gen << 8) | channel) >>> 0`, or `-1` if spriteId is unknown.
- Pass handle to `stop()` for ABA-safe stopping.
- First play on a virgin channel: gen=0, handle equals channel index (backwards-compatible for opaque usage).
- `buffer?: AudioBuffer | null` - optional per-play buffer override.
- Pan is scheduled at start-time so a stolen voice keeps its pan through its fade-out.

### stop(handle)
Stops the specific play. Stale handles (channel stolen or already ended) are silent no-ops.

### voiceNode(handle)
Returns the per-voice spatial node for a live handle, else `null`. PannerNode in positional
mode (write `.positionX/Y/Z` for full 3D), StereoPannerNode in stereo mode, or the per-voice
`Array(N)` of lane GainNodes in discrete mode (write `.gain.value` on lane k to place the
voice; the array is pre-allocated, so the call allocates nothing). Generation-checked and
fail-closed like `stop()`: stolen, stopped, expired, or bogus handles return `null`. The seam
lite-audio uses to set 3D position without reaching into pool internals.

### isPlaying(handle)
Returns `true` iff the handle still names a sounding voice. Same test `stop()` runs internally.

### activeCount()
Returns the number of currently sounding voices (0..capacity). Allocation-free.

### stopAll()
Stops every active channel, invalidates all previously issued handles.

### destroy()
Stops all sounds, disconnects every node the pool built, releases references. Idempotent.

See source file AudioPool.js for full JSDoc and inline comments.
